record.label: Spacetime bound of 369,800 on 100 qubits
record.statement: The paper reports $3{,}698$ $T$ gates on 100 qubits for the final circuit, giving a spacetime cost of $369{,}800$.
record.boundary: The list count is the sum of the assigned costs of all operations. Its equality gives $3{,}698$. The compilation theorem uses an inequality, so that total becomes an upper bound on the compiled primitive $T$ count. With 50 data wires and 50 ancillas, the proved spacetime bound is $369{,}800$.
